name: Holy Edge widens Scourgebane and Scarlet Hammer (#3055)
contract: Holy Edge is a flat SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS passive on the Scourgebane and Scarlet Hammer family mask: rank 1 (706312) adds 1 and rank 2 (707853) adds 2. Scourgebane's proc (801832) and Scarlet Hammer (807035) each declare one chain target, so the modified counts are 2 and 3.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Holy Edge rank 1 adds one Scourgebane target
Holy Edge rank 2 adds two Scourgebane targets
Holy Edge rank 2 adds two Scarlet Hammer targets
